notes: Kiln: a Uniswap v4 hook for a new ETH/ZTO pool on Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1). Only the Launcher is deployed by the factory. Its constructor takes three addresses and makes no external call: zto = ZTO ERC-20 (18 decimals) 0xd782bdea4ef02a0bd391eb9089470c8080f0a68e, pepeo = Pepeolithic PEPEO ERC-721 0x765956a7307222346b08fff681820a5d77e92028, poolManager = Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90. The Kiln contract (src/Kiln.sol) is NOT listed: the Launcher creates it itself with CREATE2 in its permissionless, once-only open(bytes32 salt, uint160 sqrtPriceX96), passing the same (zto, pepeo, poolManager), and reverts unless the Kiln address carries exactly the beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta and afterSwapReturnDelta permission bits (low 14 bits = 0x00CC). A Kiln deployed directly by the factory would sit at an address without those bits and could not serve as the hook. open() then initializes the ETH/ZTO pool (native ETH currency0, ZTO currency1, static lpFee 2000 = 0.20%, tickSpacing 60, Kiln as hook) at sqrtPriceX96 and emits Opened(kiln, poolId). No liquidity is added by the Launcher; the deployer adds a ZTO-only range position afterwards through the normal PositionManager. After deployment: read launcher.initCodeHash(), mine a salt off-chain so that the CREATE2 address (keccak256(0xff ++ launcher ++ salt ++ initCodeHash)[12:]) ends in hook bits 0x00CC (launcher.kilnAddress(salt) checks a candidate), then call launcher.open(salt, sqrtPriceX96) from any account. All other numbers are code constants in Kiln: pass tiers minPepes 0/1/3/7/12/21 with kilnCut 13000/10000/7500/5000/2500/0 hundredths of a bip (tier 21 pays no cut), spreadBps 1500, depth 50, ZTO decimals 18. Nothing is upgradeable, pausable or ownable; no admin exists in either contract, so there is no owner argument and $owner is not used. The Kiln's ZTO reserve can never be withdrawn, only paid out for Pepeolithic pieces via sell()/buy(); seed() and collect() are permissionless. Caveats documented in README: the fee pass reads PEPEO.balanceOf(tx.origin) during the swap only (no block-held guard), and pieces sent to the Kiln by plain transfer instead of sell() are not inventory and are stuck.
